# Шапка файла

include:
  - local: a.yml

stages:
  - build
  - test
  - deploy

variables:
  A: 1

# Шаблон
.base:
  image: node:20

# Сборка
build:
  stage: build # этап
  image: "node:20"
  script:
    - npm ci
    # внутри списка
    - npm run build
  needs: []
  # в конце задания

test:
  stage: test
  extends: .base
  needs:
    - build
    - job: lint
      optional: true
  dependencies: [build, lint]
  script: echo test
  when: manual
  allow_failure: true

lint:
  stage: test
  script: [lint]
  tags: [docker, linux]
  needs: build

deploy:
  stage: deploy
  extends: [.base]
  environment: 'prod'
  timeout: 1h
  interruptible: true
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"
      when: manual
    - when: never
  script:
    - |
      echo один
      echo два

  stage: test
  extends: .base

  allow_failure: true
  image: alpine:3

  stage: test
  script: [lint]
  tags: [docker, linux]
  needs: build

  timeout: 1h
  interruptible: true

  image: "node:20"
  script:
    - npm ci
    # внутри списка
    - npm run build
  needs: []
  # в конце задания

test:
  stage: test
  extends: .base
  needs:
    - build
    - job: lint
      optional: true
  dependencies: [build, lint]
  script: echo test
  when: manual
  allow_failure: true

  script: [lint]
  tags: [docker, linux]
  needs: build

deploy:
  stage: deploy
  extends: [.base]
  environment: 'prod'
  timeout: 1h
  interruptible: true
  script:
    - |
